mechanism: Both drugs reduce intraglomerular pressure through different mechanisms (ACE inhibition and SGLT2 inhibition), increasing risk of acute kidney injury and hyperkalemia, particularly in patients with baseline renal impairment or diabetes.
action: Monitor renal function (eGFR, creatinine) and serum potassium regularly; adjust doses based on renal status and ensure adequate hydration; use with caution in patients with eGFR <30 mL/min.
